test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In Union Budget 2023-24, an aspirational Blocks Programme covering how many blocks has been launched?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**500 Blocks**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Aspirational Blocks Programme** is a newly launched initiative under the **Union Budget 2023-24**.
 
• This program aims to cover **500 blocks** across the country.
 
• The focus is on enhancing the **developmental outcomes** in these blocks through targeted interventions.
 
• It is designed to address **critical developmental gaps** and improve the quality of life for citizens residing in these blocks.
 
• The program builds upon the success of the earlier **Aspirational Districts Programme**, which aimed to transform **underdeveloped districts**.
 
• Key areas of intervention under the Aspirational Blocks Programme include **health, education, agriculture, infrastructure, and skill development**.
 
• It is aligned with the government’s vision of achieving **inclusive growth** and ensuring no one is left behind in the development process.
 
• The program involves collaboration between **central, state, and local governments** for effective implementation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Aspirational Districts Programme, which serves as a foundation for this initiative, was launched by **NITI Aayog in January 2018**. It focused on improving outcomes in **112 underdeveloped districts**.
 
• The selection of blocks for the Aspirational Blocks Programme is based on **developmental indicators** such as literacy rates, health outcomes, and infrastructure deficits.
 
• This program is in line with India’s commitment to achieving the **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)** by 2030.
